{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module SmartContract.AccessControl where

import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.IORef
import GHC.Generics
import System.FilePath ((</>), takeFileName, normalise, splitDirectories, isRelative)
import System.Directory (listDirectory, doesDirectoryExist, canonicalizePath)

data Role = Admin | Auditor | Validator | Public
  deriving (Show, Eq, Ord, Generic)

data Permission = ReadChain | WriteChain | ListNodes | AdminPanel | BrowseStorage
  deriving (Show, Eq, Ord, Generic)

data User = User
  { userId   :: Text
  , userRole :: Role
  , userPerms :: [Permission]
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

type ACL = Map Text User

rolePermissions :: Role -> [Permission]
rolePermissions Admin     = [ReadChain, WriteChain, ListNodes, AdminPanel, BrowseStorage]
rolePermissions Auditor   = [ReadChain, ListNodes, BrowseStorage]
rolePermissions Validator = [ReadChain, WriteChain, ListNodes]
rolePermissions Public    = [ReadChain]

initACL :: ACL
initACL = Map.fromList
  [ ("admin01", User "admin01" Admin (rolePermissions Admin))
  , ("auditor01", User "auditor01" Auditor (rolePermissions Auditor))
  , ("validator01", User "validator01" Validator (rolePermissions Validator))
  , ("public01", User "public01" Public (rolePermissions Public))
  ]

data StorageConfig = StorageConfig
  { baseStoragePath :: FilePath
  , maxDepth        :: Int
  , allowedPrefixes :: [FilePath]
  } deriving (Show)

defaultConfig :: StorageConfig
defaultConfig = StorageConfig
  { baseStoragePath = "/var/blockchain/storage"
  , maxDepth = 3
  , allowedPrefixes = ["/var/blockchain/storage/blocks", "/var/blockchain/storage/state"]
  }

-- | Canonicalize and validate a requested path
validatePath :: StorageConfig -> FilePath -> IO (Either Text FilePath)
validatePath cfg requestedPath = do
  let base = baseStoragePath cfg
      combined = base </> requestedPath
  canonicalized <- canonicalizePath combined
  canonBase <- canonicalizePath base
  let components = splitDirectories canonicalized
      depth = length components - length (splitDirectories canonBase)
      isUnderBase = T.isPrefixOf (T.pack canonBase) (T.pack canonicalized)
  if not isUnderBase
    then return $ Left "Path escapes storage root"
    else if depth > maxDepth cfg
         then return $ Left "Path exceeds maximum depth"
         else return $ Right canonicalized

-- | Check if user has required permission
checkPermission :: ACL -> Text -> Permission -> Either Text User
checkPermission acl uid perm =
  case Map.lookup uid acl of
    Nothing -> Left "User not found"
    Just user ->
      if perm `elem` userPerms user
        then Right user
        else Left "Insufficient permissions"

-- | Core directory listing function for blockchain storage browsing
-- This implements the storage explorer for the smart contract platform
listStorageDirectory :: StorageConfig -> ACL -> Text -> FilePath -> IO (Either Text [FilePath])
listStorageDirectory cfg acl uid path = do
  case checkPermission acl uid BrowseStorage of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right user -> do
      pathResult <- validatePath cfg path
      case pathResult of
        Left err -> return $ Left err
        Right validPath -> do
          exists <- doesDirectoryExist validPath
          if exists
            then do
              contents <- listDirectory validPath
              let filtered = applyRoleFilter (userRole user) contents
              return $ Right filtered
            else return $ Left "Directory does not exist"

-- | Filter directory contents based on role
-- Admin sees everything, Auditor sees blocks and logs, others see blocks only
applyRoleFilter :: Role -> [FilePath] -> [FilePath]
applyRoleFilter Admin files = files
applyRoleFilter Auditor files = filter (\f -> isBlockFile f || isLogFile f || isPublicFile f) files
applyRoleFilter _ files = filter isPublicFile files

isBlockFile :: FilePath -> Bool
isBlockFile f = T.isSuffixOf ".block" (T.pack f)

isLogFile :: FilePath -> Bool
isLogFile f = T.isSuffixOf ".log" (T.pack f)

isPublicFile :: FilePath -> Bool
isPublicFile f = T.isSuffixOf ".block" (T.pack f) || T.isSuffixOf ".meta" (T.pack f)

-- | Query handler for the contract's storage explorer endpoint
handleStorageQuery :: IORef StorageConfig -> IORef ACL -> Text -> Text -> IO (Either Text [FilePath])
handleStorageQuery cfgRef aclRef uid rawPath = do
  cfg <- readIORef cfgRef
  acl <- readIORef aclRef
  let pathStr = T.unpack rawPath
  listStorageDirectory cfg acl uid pathStr

-- | Batch query - list multiple paths at once (used by block explorers)
batchListStorage :: IORef StorageConfig -> IORef ACL -> Text -> [Text] -> IO (Map Text (Either Text [FilePath]))
batchListStorage cfgRef aclRef uid paths = do
  results <- mapM (\p -> do
    result <- handleStorageQuery cfgRef aclRef uid p
    return (p, result)) paths
  return $ Map.fromList results

-- | Initialize the contract storage system
initStorage :: IO (IORef StorageConfig, IORef ACL)
initStorage = do
  cfgRef <- newIORef defaultConfig
  aclRef <- newIORef initACL
  return (cfgRef, aclRef)
